parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description: The device name query condition. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The current page number. Pages start from page 1. Maximum value: 10000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
